WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
summary AS (
  SELECT fundflux, project_count,
         SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(project_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT fundflux,
       project_count,
       CAST(project_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share,
       project_count - avg_count AS above_average
FROM summary
WHERE project_count > avg_count;
